REQ-0003 Amplitude ceiling — subsystem allocation

draft · refines REQ-0002 · verified by inspection, test

The pulse-generator ASIC shall enforce a hard current-limit circuit, independent of firmware, as the subsystem-level implementation of the system-level ceiling in REQ-0002, so the ceiling holds under the single-fault conditions of REF-0002.
